title: Automations : change max profile percentage hard limit
symptom: For high-fat meals, blood glucose rises late and high; the automation that raises profile % is limited to a hard-coded maximum of 130%, which is insufficient, requiring manual adjustment, especially at night.
cause: The hard-coded maximum profile percentage of 130% is not sufficient for high-fat/protein meals.
fix: No fix was provided; maintainer stated this is not what automation was designed for, and suggested using extended carbs for high-fat protein meals or switching profile with automation.
evidence_quote: The hard coded maximum 130% is not sufficient. At least 150% or, even better 180% limit would be much better.
